name: workfile
title: Draft appraisal workfile
for_each: select id,code from assignments order by code

sections.title: Recorded instructions
sections.note: Internal workfile. Not a signed valuation, lender report or certificate of compliance.

sections.title: Property
sections.sql: select p.code,p.address,p.property_type,p.area_sqm,p.interest,p.source_ref from properties p join assignments a on a.property_id=p.id where a.id=$1

sections.title: Comparable sales
sections.sql: select comparable,address,sale_date,currency,sale_amount,area_sqm,adjustment_pct,weight,adjusted_rate_amount,reason,verification_ref from comparison_grid where assignment_id=$1 order by comparable

sections.title: Recorded evidence
sections.sql: select kind,reference,note,actor from evidence where assignment_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Outstanding checks
sections.sql: select rule,issue from compliance_issues where assignment_id=$1 order by rule

sections.title: Peer review
sections.sql: select reviewer,reference,note,created_at from reviews where assignment_id=$1 order by created_at

name: review-memo
title: Draft peer review memorandum
for_each: select id,code from review_ready order by code

sections.title: Review state
sections.note: Recorded peer review of the current workfile. The authorised valuer remains responsible for any final opinion and issue.

sections.title: Reviewer evidence
sections.sql: select reviewer,reference,note,created_at from reviews where assignment_id=$1 order by created_at
